name: Rhodes Summer Academy 2027
what_you_do: Live on campus for 2 weeks and take 1 college class for 2 credits. Choices include chemistry, personal genetics or medicine in the ancient world. Afternoons have workshops and college prep advice.
who_can_apply: High school students who will be sophomores, juniors or seniors.
pay_detail: $3200 tuition, including room and board. Financial aid will be available. $200 application discount if you register by March 15.
deadline_text: Applications are open as of Nov 4, 2026. Registration deadline: pay a $300 deposit by Apr 15, 2027, after you are admitted. Register by Mar 15, 2027 for a $200 application discount.
how_to_apply: Make an account and fill out the online application. After you are admitted, pay a $300 deposit by Apr 15 to hold your spot. Email summeracademy@rhodes.edu with questions.
notes: Students pick 1 class and go to 2 sessions a day. The page says classes run June 12 to 25, 2027. It also says move in is June 21 and move out is July 2. Confirm the dates with summeracademy@rhodes.edu.
